package.name: ai-efficiency-operating-system
package.purpose: Maximize verified goal attainment per unit of context, tool work, latency, repeated effort and human correction without shrinking protected capabilities, concurrency, reasoning depth, answer quality or evidence standards.
package.evolution_thesis: Implicit context is hidden state. Convert assumptions about goal, instructions, memory, context lineage, route/version, delivery, ownership and completion into explicit testable contracts.

naming_policy.collision_rule: Extend the existing canonical semantic owner before creating an alias.

task_contract.rule: Only an explicit user correction or stronger owning-target evidence may replace contradicted assumptions; retrieval, memory, tools, agents and summaries cannot silently redefine the root task.

instruction_contract.rule: No universal precedence is assumed across hosts. Durable rules carry provenance and are retested when host, model, protocol, path, runtime or observed behavior changes.

review_topology.name: orchestrator
review_topology.duty: task contract, root goal, dependency graph, acceptance ownership

review_topology.name: source-research
review_topology.duty: recover original chat, repository and current external evidence

review_topology.name: root-cause
review_topology.duty: cluster shared mechanisms and design discriminating tests

review_topology.name: adversarial
review_topology.duty: attack omissions, proxy wins, regressions, injection and false completion

review_topology.name: cross-exam
review_topology.duty: separate user directive, evidence and synthesis; challenge names and claims

review_topology.name: implementer
review_topology.duty: identity-locked scoped mutation with writer ownership

review_topology.name: verifier
review_topology.duty: structure, exact revision, alternate-path, read-back and owning-runtime acceptance

review_topology.name: risk
review_topology.duty: rollback, permission, blast radius, compatibility and irreversible-action risk

review_topology.name: adjudicator
review_topology.duty: retain best evidence-weighted solution and unresolved minority evidence

requires: non-shared execution evidence when independence matters
real_agent_gate.forbidden: Personas, prompt lanes, branches or role labels alone do not prove independent runtime agents.

context_policy.lineage: Each agent/session records parent checkpoint, inherited digest, local delta and reconciliation.
context_policy.compaction: Preserve semantic units, tool-call/result pairs, protected invariants and open obligations; roll back lossy compaction.
context_policy.observation_cache: Cache stable large observations by target identity + query/path + revision/version + content hash; invalidate on any identity/content change.

retry_policy.after_cap: open circuit breaker or change hypothesis/route/permission/version

continuity_policy.failed_turn_rule: Blocked, malformed, empty, interrupted or invalid turns are quarantined and do not become durable truth.

protocol_policy.mcp_2026_07_28: Use stateless 2026-07-28 semantics only for peers that support/negotiate that version.
protocol_policy.codex_2026_08_24: codex mcp-server is deprecated; Codex app server is the current OpenAI route.

performance_contract.hot_path: Process deltas; move full-history/hash/evidence transforms to cold paths/checkpoints.

modules.purpose: Compile the current request into a durable task contract before substantive work.
modules.example: Freeze PRIMARY_TASK and acceptance tests before GitHub mutation.

modules.purpose: Apply explicit corrections as authoritative deltas and invalidate only contradicted downstream assumptions.
modules.when: user corrects goal, path, method or facts
modules.example: A newer correction supersedes the assistant's earlier route without deleting unrelated constraints.

modules.purpose: Reject actions with no credible causal path to the active task contract.
modules.when: tools, retrieval or agents suggest neighboring work
modules.example: Do not build an unrelated plugin merely because a tool is available.

modules.purpose: Lock exact surface, repo, ref, path, version, runtime, owner, supersession and permission before mutation.
modules.example: Re-read live main and changed path before replacing a skill file.

modules.purpose: Improve efficiency without reducing protected features, concurrency, depth, quality or workload.
modules.example: Do not close chats to make multi-chat switching look faster.

modules.purpose: Keep a lean front door and load detailed context only when causally relevant.
modules.when: many tools, skills or long histories exist
modules.example: Load full GitHub write schemas only when a write is needed.

modules.purpose: Keep one semantic owner for each durable rule and replace redundant copies with references.
modules.when: instruction bloat or duplicate skills appear
modules.example: Retain one canonical no-goal-shrink rule rather than five aliases.

modules.purpose: Compact histories while retaining task contract, evidence, contradictions, minority hypotheses and obligations.
modules.example: Summary keeps the unresolved runtime blocker and exact evidence pointer.

modules.purpose: Discover broadly but load/call only tools that materially improve the current decision or execution.
modules.example: Do not load every connector schema for a GitHub-only task.

modules.purpose: Track capability from discovery through verified invocation instead of binary availability.
modules.example: Installed is not the same as invokable or verified.

modules.purpose: Bind claim strength to E0-E6 evidence.
modules.when: material claim or completion state advances
modules.example: GitHub source presence stays below host-live proof.

modules.purpose: Track consequential research dimensions as covered, partial, unknown or excluded.
modules.example: Expose missing runtime evidence even after many documentation sources are collected.

modules.purpose: Maintain competing mechanisms and prefer discriminating tests over confirmation-only accumulation.
modules.example: Distinguish retry storm, lock contention and platform rejection with tests.

modules.purpose: Count work as deeper only when causal model, evidence strength, hypotheses or failure boundary changes.
modules.example: Waiting longer with no new evidence scores zero depth gain.

modules.purpose: Stop debate when testing, execution or read-back has higher expected information gain.
modules.example: Run the exact repro instead of collecting the fifteenth duplicate source.

modules.purpose: Activate the smallest coalition adding distinct evidence, method, capability, falsification or verification value.
modules.example: Use source, adversarial and verifier roles rather than broadcasting to clones.

modules.purpose: Preserve new evidence, contradictions, falsifiers and strong minority hypotheses while compressing agreement.
modules.example: Keep one dissenting direct-source correction over nine paraphrases.

modules.purpose: Require distinct runtime/session receipts before claiming independent agents.
modules.example: Ten audit lanes with no sessions remain workstreams, not ten agents.

modules.purpose: Parallelize independent reads and serialize conflicting writes to mutable state.
modules.when: cross-chat or multi-worker task mutates shared target
modules.example: Research in parallel; one writer updates canonical main.

modules.purpose: Keep shared locks around only the minimum atomic transition and move slow external I/O outside when safe.
modules.when: locks or leases guard shared state
modules.example: Lock admission/ownership, not entire network settlement.

modules.purpose: Persist task/run identity and an event journal so continuation does not depend on chat prose.
modules.example: Checkpoint irreversible effects and pending obligations.

modules.purpose: Use idempotency and authority generations so retry/resume cannot duplicate or stale-write effects.
modules.when: retries, resume or concurrent writers are possible
modules.example: A stale worker is fenced after a newer owner advances generation.

modules.purpose: Prefer API/CLI/MCP/DOM/accessibility routes that do not steal desktop focus.
modules.example: Use a background structured route before mouse/screen control.

modules.purpose: Bridge ordinary Chat to an authorized execution runtime instead of confusing conversation relay with execution.
modules.example: Prompt copying without executor receipts is not capability handoff.

modules.purpose: Keep full-history materialization, hashing and global scans off incremental hot paths.
modules.example: Process only changed assistant material per increment.

modules.purpose: Scope retry/backpressure and cache stable observations to avoid duplicate work and global stalls.
modules.example: Respect Retry-After without blocking unrelated chats.

modules.purpose: Advance completion only with evidence matching the exact target and require read-back after mutation.
modules.example: Commit receipt plus exact main fetch proves repo mutation, not host activation.

modules.purpose: Use baseline, failure attribution, minimal causal patch, holdout/regression and promote-or-rollback.
modules.example: Reject a patch that improves target cases but breaks protection cases.

modules.purpose: Compress the final response to decisive result, evidence, mechanism, action and material limitations.
modules.when: substantive work is ready to report
modules.example: Report commit/read-back and blockers instead of raw search logs.

modules.purpose: Enumerate instruction sources, host/surface scope, merge semantics and precedence; probe ambiguity.
modules.example: Do not assume AGENTS.md and account instructions have universal precedence.

modules.purpose: Attach source, rationale, scope/version and retest triggers to durable rules.
modules.example: Revalidate an old workaround after host/model/protocol change.

modules.purpose: Track parent checkpoint, inherited state digest and local delta for each child/resumed context.
modules.example: Child reconciles latest goal correction before writing.

modules.purpose: Prevent blocked, malformed, empty, interrupted or invalid turns from entering durable truth.
modules.when: a turn lacks a valid committed postcondition
modules.example: Auth-blocked exact-10 probe records zero verified children, not success.

modules.purpose: Compact semantic units, validate protected invariants afterward and roll back/rehydrate on loss.
modules.example: Dropping the no-fewer-chats constraint invalidates compaction.

modules.purpose: Reference stable large observations by exact target identity/version/path/hash until invalidated.
modules.example: Reuse a GitHub blob receipt while the blob SHA is unchanged.

modules.purpose: Require a strategy delta for retry, bound attempts and open a circuit breaker after repeated same-class failure.
modules.when: operation failed and retry is considered
modules.example: Do not blindly replay the same rejected POST three more times.

modules.purpose: Separate the actor that changes state from the judge that authorizes material completion.
modules.when: worker reports a critical task done
modules.example: A07 writes; A08 independently re-fetches and verifies.

modules.purpose: Persist pending state and resume on event/task signal instead of repeatedly running full reasoning during idle waits.
modules.when: long external task exposes event state
modules.example: Resume from task completion event rather than model polling loops.

modules.purpose: Keep a local capability failure scoped instead of globally degrading unrelated valid capabilities.
modules.example: Offline desktop executor does not disable GitHub research.

modules.purpose: Track SENT, DELIVERED, ACKNOWLEDGED, INCORPORATED and VERIFIED separately.
modules.example: Posted coordination message is not incorporated until receiver read-back.

modules.purpose: Bind protocol behavior to negotiated version, transport, SDK/extensions and auth semantics.
modules.example: Do not impose MCP 2026-07-28 semantics on an older peer.

modules.purpose: Exercise correctness/security invariants across materially distinct execution paths.
modules.example: Foreground permission PASS cannot certify an untested background path.

modules.purpose: Gate skill admission on positive/hard-negative triggers, compatibility, behavior coverage, paired utility and context cost; forbid self-approval.
modules.example: A skill that fires on irrelevant simple tasks fails activation precision.

modules.purpose: Promote recurrent validated mechanisms with provenance/retest triggers, not transient events.
modules.when: experience is considered for durable memory
modules.example: One outage cannot become permanent tool-unavailable memory.

modules.purpose: Separate raw input, corrected intent and generated rewrite while preserving proper nouns, technical terms and final corrections.
modules.example: 2 PM—no, 3:30 PM resolves to 3:30 without inventing facts.

modules.purpose: Use an independent monotonic witness/frontier to detect stale or whole-store rollback when replay would be unsafe.
modules.when: durable state may restore older snapshots
modules.example: Primary store at frontier A is rejected when surviving witness proves irreversible frontier B.

modules.purpose: Verify declared-to-actual and actual-to-declared artifact coverage.
modules.example: A report cannot validate seven files when only five physically exist.

promotion_gate.host_specific: HOST_LIVE or higher requires target-host runtime evidence.
